hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -Eq '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])git[[:space:]]+stash([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' && jq -nc --arg r 'Blocked `git stash`. This working tree is likely shared with other agents running in parallel, so `git stash` / `push` / `save` would yank ALL uncommitted changes (theirs included) off the tree, and `pop` / `clear` can clobber or drop in-progress work. Do NOT stash. To set your own changes aside, commit them to a branch or a separate git worktree, or just leave them in place. If you truly need stash here, ask the human to lift this guard via /hooks.' '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$r}}' || true
